name: hepi-mono
description: Monorepo for HEPI Pi Coding Agent extensions.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hheei/pi-ext-core run build && pnpm --filter @hheei/pi-ext-memory --filter @hheei/pi-ext-addon --filter @hheei/pi-ext-tools --filter @hheei/pi-bg-bash --filter @hheei/pi-apply-patch --filter @hheei/pi-python-eval --filter @hheei/pi-todo --filter @hheei/pi-ext-ui --filter @hheei/pi-settings --filter @hheei/pi-status --filter @hheei/pi-optimizer --filter @hheei/pi-subagents --filter @hheei/pi-loadout --filter @hheei/pi-web-access run build
scripts.check: biome check . && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.publish:packages: pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:packages && node scripts/publish-packages.mjs
scripts.publish:dry-run: pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:packages && node scripts/publish-packages.mjs --dry-run
